content: Graph rendering cliff: D3/SVG and Canvas force layouts degrade at low hundreds of nodes. Cytoscape.js works to ~5k-50k nodes; Sigma.js (WebGL) handles thousands smoothly and is the practical choice above ~50k. Force-directed LAYOUT computation (not just rendering) is the bottleneck; run layout in a web worker or precompute/cache positions. For thousands of entities pick a WebGL renderer (Sigma.js) and avoid live force simulation on every interaction.
